clue.text: Animal is shy up to a point

parts.note: shy means coy, bashful

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the little word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
E, east, is one of the compass points

explanation.surface: A timid creature that will only go so far.
explanation.definitionFit: The coyote is a wild North American member of the dog family.

clue.text: Might it seem a cold time to start the operation?

definitions.text: Might it seem a cold time to start the operation?

parts.words: Might it seem a cold time to start the operation?
parts.note: the first word of the phrase is also a temperature reading of freezing point, so the starting moment of a military operation sounds chilly

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a planned military attack is beginning in wintry weather.
explanation.definitionFit: The planned moment a military operation begins is named with a word for nought, which as a temperature is freezing cold.

clue.text: Unable to make one's mark in the election

definitions.text: Unable to make one's mark in the election

parts.words: Unable to make one's mark in the election
parts.note: making one's mark is the cross put on a ballot paper, so someone who cannot do it has been stripped of the vote

explanation.surface: A voter who cannot make an impression on the poll's outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone deprived of the right to vote cannot put a cross on a ballot paper.

clue.text: Empty hotels converted in Africa

indicators.note: converted means changed into another form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: empty means nothing, the letter O

explanation.surface: Vacant hotels being turned into something else somewhere in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converted' rearranges HOTELS, and O (empty) follows. The definition is loose: the answer is a country that lies in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesotho is a small kingdom completely surrounded by South Africa.

clue.text: Like violins having conditions

definitions.meaning: violins have strings fitted to them
an offer with ... comes with conditions

explanation.definitionFit: Violins are strung instruments; an idiom for an offer with conditions or catches.

clue.text: Drumming design on the skin

definitions.meaning: a rhythmic beating of drums, or a military display with drums
a permanent inked picture on the body

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a rapid drumbeat signal and an inked picture on the body.

clue.text: Some bathers ignore notice

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Swimmers paying no attention to a posted warning.
explanation.definitionFit: A notice is a posted board or placard giving information, a synonym.

clue.text: Sleep like a bull

parts.note: a nap taken by a bull might be named by the second half of the word for flattening things with a heavy machine

explanation.surface: A bull snoozing in the field.
explanation.definitionFit: A light nap is this word, and with 'bull' in front it means to force through.

clue.text: Dropped in for a cold drink

definitions.text: Dropped in for a cold drink

parts.words: Dropped in for a cold drink
parts.note: the reading is of a casual social call, but it describes cubes put into a glass to chill it

explanation.surface: Someone popping round to a friend's for a chilled beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: Frozen water cubes are what gets dropped into a glass to chill a drink.

clue.text: Very sad soldier in broken down cart

indicators.note: in places the soldier inside the rearranged letters
broken down suggests the cart is smashed, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier stuck in a broken-down cart, which is a pity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken down' rearranges CART to TRAC, and 'in' puts GI inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tragic is deeply distressing, causing great sorrow.

clue.text: Sour-tempered doctor got out of bed

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor
got out of bed means rose

explanation.surface: A grumpy doctor who got out of bed on the wrong side.
explanation.definitionFit: Morose means sullen and gloomy, ill-humoured.

clue.text: Failing to ring Timothy back before a bell is heard

parts.note: a ring is O-shaped

indicators.note: back means the short name is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: ting is the sound a small bell makes

explanation.surface: Someone forgetting to phone Timothy back before a bell sounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Failing to do something is leaving it out or neglecting it.

clue.text: Start successfully at the airport

definitions.meaning: an idiom for a project making a good beginning
literally what an aircraft does on take-off

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for a project launching well is literally what aircraft do on take-off.

clue.text: Refusal of five to leave the fleet

indicators.note: to leave means the five departs from the word for the fleet

parts.note: a nation's fleet is its navy
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Five sailors refused permission to quit the fleet.
explanation.definitionFit: Nay is an old word for no, a refusal.

clue.text: In being rigorous Stanley accepts equality

indicators.note: accepts means the name takes in another piece inside it

parts.note: Stan is short for Stanley
par means equality, as in 'on a par'

explanation.surface: A strict man called Stanley agreeing that all are equal.
explanation.definitionFit: Spartan means austere and strict, after the harsh ways of ancient Sparta.

clue.text: I leave couple near St Austell

indicators.note: leave means the letter I departs from the word for a couple

parts.note: a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: Someone abandoning their partner in a Cornish town.
explanation.walkthrough: St Austell is a town in Cornwall, in south-west England; the answer is a village beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Par is a village and harbour on the Cornish coast just east of St Austell.

clue.text: Good looker in the middle of the road

definitions.meaning: a feline's organ of sight, very good in the dark

definitions.text: in the middle of the road
definitions.meaning: a road stud with reflectors set along the centre line

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain, reflective studs set in the road surface are named after the shining eyes of a feline.
explanation.definitionFit: A feline sees well at night; the British reflective road stud is named after that eye.

clue.text: High-fliers' pranks

definitions.meaning: songbirds that sing while soaring very high

explanation.definitionFit: The bird soars high while singing; the plural noun also means frolics or mischievous fun.

clue.text: Wave on the ship's doctor

parts.note: a surge is a great wave

explanation.surface: A big wave hitting the doctor aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A naval medical officer on a ship is traditionally given this title.

clue.text: Coast to coast race

parts.note: a run from one seaboard to the other would literally cover the whole land, and is also the name of an overland running event

explanation.surface: A race across an entire continent from one shore to the other.
explanation.definitionFit: An overland running race over fields rather than track, which literally would span a land.

clue.text: Ragout containing a highly seasoned sausage

indicators.note: containing means the stew word holds the letter A inside it

parts.note: a salmi is a ragout of game birds

explanation.surface: A spicy stew with sausage in it.
explanation.walkthrough: SALMI is a rich French stew of game.
explanation.definitionFit: Salami is a strongly spiced Italian cured sausage.

clue.text: Serviceable new fuels including uranium

indicators.note: including means the rearranged fuels take U inside
new means the fuels appear in a fresh arrangement

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: Novel fuels with uranium that prove practical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges FUELS and 'including' puts U among those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Serviceable means usable, fit for its purpose.

clue.text: Make notes about the spring bulge

indicators.note: about means the singing word goes round the spring word

parts.note: to make musical notes is to sing
a well is a spring of water

explanation.surface: Composing music about a lump that appeared in springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: A swelling is a raised lump or protuberance.

clue.text: Accompanying repartee is hot

parts.note: repartee is quick wit
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Clever banter that is sizzling.
explanation.definitionFit: Accompanying as a preposition means together with, alongside.

clue.text: Talk about the Continental villa

indicators.note: about means the talk word goes round the French article

parts.note: to talk is to chat
le is French for 'the'

explanation.surface: Discussing a holiday house in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: A chalet is a wooden holiday house, like a Swiss mountain villa.

clue.text: Obstruction of course when my tie's knotted

indicators.note: knotted means tied up, so the letters are tangled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the 's standing for 'is'

explanation.surface: A golfer hindered on the course when a tie gets tangled.
explanation.walkthrough: In old golf, a ball lying between another ball and the hole blocked its path; that is the obstruction 'of course'.
explanation.definitionFit: On a golf course, a ball blocking another's line to the hole was an obstacle of this name.

clue.text: Mineral from round edges of ravine

parts.note: a round shape is O

indicators.note: edges of picks out the first and last letters of the ravine

explanation.surface: Mineral deposits found around the rim of a gorge.
explanation.definitionFit: Ore is rock from which a metal or mineral can be extracted.

clue.text: Take a sleeping berth on the way back and lump it

indicators.note: on the way back means the verb is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: to bunk is to sleep in a bunk

explanation.surface: Grudgingly accepting a cramped berth for the return journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A knub is a small knob or lump, a variant of nub.
